name: Lugaidh mac Con Roí

attributes.attribute: son of the hero Cu Ro
mother of Lugaidh who betrayed his father

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lugaidh mac Con Ro was an Irish hero of the old tales. He was the son of the great warrior Cu Ro and an enemy of the hero Cuchulainn. Some accounts say his mother was Blaithna, the woman who had betrayed his father. It was said to be for that reason that Lugaidh came to hate Cuchulainn.

okr.objective: Document Lugaidh mac Con Ro as the son of Cu Ro and an enemy of Cuchulainn.
